title: Square-cube law in Star Wars
question: For the 58 characters other than Jabba with height and mass, is the slope of log mass on log height 3, 2, or less?

issues.text: Masses are fan estimates, often of the actor or the costume.
issues.fix: Read the slope as a property of the films' design, not of alien biology.

issues.text: Only 59 of 82 characters have both values; prequel CGI characters are the most often missing.
issues.fix: Report n per group and the per-film share weighed.

alternatives.question: Is the slope for humans alone 2 (Quetelet)?
alternatives.why: Checks the method on the group where the answer is known.

alternatives.question: Do characters from high-gravity homeworlds weigh more for their height?
Does starship cost scale with length³?
alternatives.why: The same scaling question for machines.

hypotheses.statement: log₁₀ mass rises with log₁₀ height with slope 3.
hypotheses.null: The slope is 3 (a scaled body); rejected when its ±2 SE interval excludes 3.

hypotheses.statement: For humans the slope is 2, so the BMI does not depend on height.

strategy.detail: Droid by species name; empty species or Human → human; the rest alien.
10^(log_m − a − b log_h) with the fit on everyone but Jabba.

data.request: Surface gravity of each homeworld (planets.gravity, 'standard' units)
data.why: To test whether heavy-gravity worlds make heavier characters.

method.summary: log₁₀ mass on log₁₀ height per group; the slope with its standard error against 3 and 2.

steps.title: People, species, planets
steps.detail: SWAPI's full lists; numbers parsed from text, 'unknown' → null.

steps.title: Human, alien, droid
steps.detail: Empty species is mostly human; Jabba fitted with and without.

steps.title: Mass for height
steps.detail: Each character's mass over the fitted prediction, and over a scaled Luke (77 kg · (h/172)³).

steps.title: Which law
steps.detail: Slope 1.54 ± 0.12 without Jabba: H1 rejected (t = −11.9); humans 1.98 ± 0.80: H2 not rejected.

caveats: Fan-recorded values from Lucasfilm's films, not measurements.
Masses are missing for 23 characters, most from the prequels.
SWAPI leaves species empty for 32 people; Sly Moore (Umbaran) is counted as human.
